column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for commerce/collection records (e.g., 'COM001').
A SMALLINT tally of merchandise purchases (e.g., 5).
A DECIMAL(10,2) total spent on merchandise in USD (e.g., 120.00).
An INT indicating how many digital items the fan owns (e.g., 20).
An INT indicating how many physical items the fan owns (e.g., 10).
A DECIMAL(5,1) measuring the fan’s collection completion percentage (e.g., '75.5').
An enum (TradingActivityLevel_enum) describing the fan’s trading or exchange activity (High, Low, Medium).
